Here is the Semgrep rule in YAML format that detects a potential vulnerability in the Spring Security Samples repository:
```yaml
rules:
- id: "vuln-spring-security-samples-4e3bec90"
  pattern: |
    SecurityFilterChain securityFilterChain(HttpSecurity http, MvcRequestMatcher.Builder mvc) throws Exception {
      .requestMatchers(mvc.pattern("/login"), mvc.pattern("/resources/**")).permitAll()
    }
  languages: ["java"]
  message: "Potential path traversal vulnerability in Spring Security Samples repository."
  severity: ERROR
  metadata:
    source-url: github.com/spring-projects/spring-security-samples/commit/4e3bec904a5467db28ea33e25ac9d90524b53d66
    category: security
    cwe: CWE-22
```
This rule matches the vulnerable code structure in the patch and provides a clear message explaining both the problem and solution. The `pattern-not` field is not included because there is no fixed version of this vulnerability.
